newsitem.title: USA: George Stoe joins Wise Metals as executive VP.
newsitem.headline: George Stoe joins Wise Metals as executive VP.

text.p: George Stoe, the former executive vice president of Alumax Inc's mill products division, is joining Wise Metals in a newly created position of executive vice president, Wise Metals said in a statement.

"Mr. Stoe's responsibilities will include helping direct the firm's effort to broaden its role from one of physical activity into that of a 'full service' merchant house serving the aluminum industry," the statement said.
The appointment is effective "within a couple of weeks," a company executive said.
Stoe headed Alumax's mill products division before suddenly submitting his resignation in early March. His departure was attributed to "management diffetences."
He is a 28-year veteran of the aluminum industry.
